title: Case 05: The Vanishing Witness
subtitle: A protected witness disappears from a locked safe house six hours before trial. The cameras never go offline.
loop_reset_text: The apartment lights dim. The hallway camera rewinds twenty-eight minutes. Eva is back inside.

safehouse.name: Safe House
safehouse.description: The apartment is empty but staged: a broken glass, fake blood and one envelope of emergency cash.

hall.name: Hallway
hall.description: Two officers guard the floor while the camera repeats the same clean sequence.

service.name: Service Shaft
service.description: A maintenance passage links the safe house to the freight elevator without crossing the monitored hallway.

court.name: Prosecutor Staging Room
court.description: Trial schedules, transport routes and sealed witness instructions sit behind government locks.

morgan.name: Detective Morgan Shaw
dialogue: Eva was secure when I left.
Only my supervisor knew the transport route.
I changed the escort plan after receiving an anonymous warning.

contradiction.result: Morgan's duplicate key and the camera-loop timing show he could enter without appearing in the hallway footage.

morgan.asma_open: Watch Detective Morgan Shaw. Do not decide too early. Ask one thing at a time and listen for what changes.
tells: Detective Morgan Shaw answers quickly, but their eyes move toward the nearest exit.
This time Detective Morgan Shaw reacts before you finish the question. They remember nothing, but the pattern changed.
Detective Morgan Shaw tries to repeat the same wording. One detail is different.
morgan.pressure_line: You should not know that part yet.
morgan.shadow_reveal: Detective Morgan Shaw changes route after the interview and briefly checks a place they never mentioned.

dialogue: The safe house was never compromised.

contradiction.result: Iris knew the service shaft existed but did not leak it. Her new escort order was a response to the same internal threat.

timeline: 2:12 AM — Eva learns her route may be compromised.
2:19 AM — She contacts Leo from a burner phone.
2:27 AM — Camera loop begins for thirty seconds.
2:28 AM — Eva enters the service shaft.
2:35 AM — A second elevator trip follows.
2:40 AM — Safe house is found empty.
deduction_prompt: Who leaked Eva's location and followed her escape through the building's blind spot?
truth: Eva staged her own disappearance after discovering her protection route had leaked. Morgan Shaw's credentials accessed the sealed schedule, a duplicate of his key was used during the camera loop, and the second freight-elevator trip shows he followed Eva through the service shaft. Eva's escape plan was real; Morgan turned it into an ambush.
partial: You identify Morgan as the leak but fail to distinguish Eva's voluntary escape from an abduction.
wrong: Your theory ignores the camera loop and the second elevator trip. The safe house rewinds.

loop_reveals.2: Look at me. We already know Camera Loop Timing does not fit. This time, watch Duplicate Safe-House Key before anyone knows we are suspicious.
loop_reveals.3: Something is repeating too precisely. We have Camera Loop Timing and Duplicate Safe-House Key. Now we find the detail nobody expected us to remember.

action_beats.label: SEARCH THE SCENE WITH ASMA
action_beats.title: SCENE SEARCH
action_beats.text: Asma moves with you through the scene, checking what everyone else ignored. You compare positions, timing, and what looks slightly too deliberate.

action_beats.label: FOLLOW THE MOVEMENT YOU REMEMBER
action_beats.title: PURSUIT
action_beats.text: You move before the moment repeats. Asma follows your lead as you cut across the route you remember from the previous loop.

action_beats.label: CHASE BEFORE THEY DISAPPEAR
action_beats.title: CHASE
action_beats.text: The suspect bolts. You and Asma run the route you already learned in an earlier loop, cutting off the escape before it can repeat.

twist_hint: The obvious explanation for Case 05 is incomplete; one detail only makes sense after the loop repeats.
